newsitem.title: CHINA: China Merchants sells Glass stake to SIH.
newsitem.headline: China Merchants sells Glass stake to SIH.

text.p: China Merchants Holdings (International) Co Ltd said it has agreed to sell part of its interest in China Southern Glass Holdings Co Ltd to Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd (SIH).
SIH also said that it would acquire from its parent company, Shenzhen Building Materials Industrial Group Company (SBM), an 11.33 percent stake in Southern Glass, the SIH statement said.

Southern Glass was established in Shenzhen in China in 1984 and is principally engaged in processing and sale of high-quality glass products as well as hi-tech ceramic products and other related materials, the statement said.

The consideration price of HK$408 million is based on a sale price of HK$5.024 per B share of Southern Glass. This represented a premium of about 30 percent to the average closing price of the B share for the five trading days prior to the announcement, the statement said.

On July 16, Southern Glass announced a three for ten rights share offer at 4.00 yuan per rights share, and SIH said it intends to take up its full allotment of rights shares or about 38.86 million shares.
China Merchants shares were up HK$0.35 at HK$22.35 on Thursday morning. Shenzhen International was up HK$0.10 at HK$1.88, and Southern Glass B shares were down HK$0.08 at HK$3.80.
